record.paper_title: Open Problems About Sumsets in Finite Abelian Groups: Minimum Sizes and Critical Numbers
record.context_brief: Restricted sumset formula when m ≤ p
record.original_question: Let G be a finite abelian group of order n, written additively, and let A={a1,...,am} be an m-element subset of G. For a positive integer h, define the h-fold restricted sumset h^A as the set of all sums λ1a1+...+λm am where each λi is either 0 or 1 and the coefficients sum to h; equivalently, h^A is the set of sums of h distinct elements of A. Let ρ^(G,m,h) be the minimum of |h^A| over all m-element subsets A of G. If p is the smallest prime divisor of n and h < m ≤ p, must ρ^(G,m,h) equal min{p, hm - h^2 + 1}?

evidence.quote: the h-fold restricted sumset: hˆA = {Σ_i=1^m λ_i ai | λ1,...,λm ∈ {0, 1}, Σ_i=1^m λi = h}
ρˆ(G, m, h) = min{|hˆA| | A ⊆ G, |A| = m}
Conjecture 6 If p is the smallest prime divisor of n and h < m ≤ p, then ρˆ(G, m, h) = min{p, hm − h2 + 1}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $n$, written additively, and let $A=\{a_1,\ldots,a_m\}\subseteq G$ be an $m$-element subset. For a positive integer $h\le m$, define the $h$-fold restricted sumset
$$h^{\wedge}A \;=\; \Big\{\sum_{i=1}^m \lambda_i a_i \;\Big|\; \lambda_i\in\{0,1\},\ \sum_{i=1}^m\lambda_i=h\Big\},$$
i.e., the set of all sums of $h$ pairwise distinct elements of $A$. Define
$$\rho^{\wedge}(G,m,h) \;=\; \min\{\,|h^{\wedge}A| : A\subseteq G,\ |A|=m\,\}.$$
Let $p$ denote the smallest prime divisor of $n$. Prove or disprove: whenever $h<m\le p$,
$$\rho^{\wedge}(G,m,h) \;=\; \min\{\,p,\ hm-h^2+1\,\}.$$
artifact.category_tag: Restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups
artifact.status_search_result: The formula matches the Dias da Silva–Hamidoune theorem (proving the Erdős–Heilbronn-type bound) for cyclic groups of prime order, but the proposed extension to arbitrary finite abelian groups with $p$ the smallest prime divisor of $|G|$ (in the range $h<m\le p$) appears in the literature as an explicit conjecture. Recent works on $\rho^{\wedge}$ and critical numbers for restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups continue to investigate this regime without reporting a full proof; no resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: On two questions about restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies ρ^(G,m,h) and related questions for finite abelian groups.
status_evidence.claim: Question about ρ^(G,m,h) for general finite abelian groups remains under active investigation.

status_evidence.title: Restricted sumset - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: |h∧A| ≥ min(p, h|A| - h^2 + 1) for nonempty A ⊂ Z_p (Dias da Silva–Hamidoune).
status_evidence.claim: The formula min{p, hm - h^2 + 1} is known for cyclic groups of prime order; extension to general abelian groups is the open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Critical Numbers for Restricted Sumsets: Rigidity and Collapse in Finite Abelian Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigation of critical numbers for restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains an active research topic without a reported general proof.
